mission: Collector rollout blocked (#197): Railway reports no redeployable copy of any collector's active image, while its agent says some copies can still be rolled back. The collector-redeploy dry run now lists only copies of the active image with Railway's redeploy and rollback flags (canRollback read separately; unknown if unreadable) and names a rollback target, to decide between a rollback-based preflight and the owner's pragmatist/perfectionist choice. Read-only.

impacts.reason: can_rollback() reads deployment.canRollback (None when unreadable); rollback_check() keeps only same-image copies, de-duplicated, flags R/B, and returns rollback_target (never the active deployment); summary adds no_rollback_target. Not part of plan_sha256.
Same-image filtering, flags, rollback target excludes the active deployment.

routes: Railway GraphQL deployment reads (read-only) in the collector-redeploy dry run
